description:
Music video animated by Ai Niina for the hit song Momen no Handkerchief by Hiromi Oota.

Note: A short version of this music video initially broadcasted on TV Asahi called "The Newsic Video", a special program where artists created videos for Showa-era tunes that didn't have a music video (as such things did not exist back then) on October 1, 2021. The full version was completed and uploaded online onto the Sony Music Japan YouTube channel the following year in 2022.
